g.text: A valuable asset used to exercise security relationships.
All links in this example model use relationship labels that
appear in the canonical model configuration.
Threat model used to exercise the full canonical security
Resource owner used to exercise ownership relationships.
Threat used to exercise threat-centric relationships
including adversaries, capabilities, victims, and risks.
Control used to exercise control/risk/constraint governance
Data store subtype used for persistence coverage.
Risk created by a threat and mitigated by a control.
